defaultHarness.title: Default agent execution mode
defaultHarness.description: Applies to new standard sessions; assistants, ACP, and sessions with an explicit mode are unaffected
defaultHarness.followLastDescription: New sessions use the execution mode last selected in the message input: {{name}}
defaultHarness.followLastEmptyDescription: No selection recorded yet; new sessions use {{name}} until you choose an execution mode in the message input
defaultHarness.fixedDescription: New sessions always use the selected execution mode; existing sessions are unchanged.
defaultHarness.loadFailed: Default execution mode settings could not be read. This setting is locked to avoid overwriting the existing configuration.

pet.title: Desktop pet
pet.petDescription: Import a Petdex ZIP pack or choose a built-in pet
pet.importHint: Download a Petdex ZIP from petdex.dev to import
pet.loadFailed: This pet could not be loaded. Check its package and sprite version in Pet settings.
pet.deleteConfirmBody: Delete this imported pet from your device? This cannot be undone.
pet.subtitle: Turning display off hides the pet and keeps your selected and imported appearances

desktopCards.title: Desktop cards
desktopCards.subtitle: Small cards outside the main window for reminders, PR status, progress, weather, and other things worth a glance
desktopCards.description: When off, cards are hidden and the agent can no longer create or update them. Existing cards are kept.
desktopCards.unsupported: Update this host to manage desktop cards.

workspaceSearch.title: Accelerated workspace search
workspaceSearch.subtitle: Speed up file search in large workspaces. Standard search remains available when this is off.

toolExecution.sectionDescription: Tool execution and waiting for an answer have separate timers; set either to 0 for no timeout

permissionPolicy.sectionDescription: Choose when tool actions need approval and which actions are allowed or denied
permissionPolicy.askDescription: Confirm before files change, commands run, or external services are accessed.
permissionPolicy.fullAccessDescription: Do not confirm each tool action.
permissionPolicy.fullAccessWarningMessage: Full access allows tools by default without asking each time.
permissionPolicy.autoApproveDescription: Automatically allow actions that would normally need confirmation.
permissionPolicy.showInChatInputDescription: Show the permission mode below the chat input so it can be changed for the current session.
permissionPolicy.globalRulesDescription: Applies to all workspaces; project and agent rules can override these, while mandatory product restrictions always take precedence
permissionPolicy.globalRulesDialogDescription: These user-level rules apply to every workspace. Later project and Agent rules can override them; enforced product restrictions remain authoritative.
permissionPolicy.globalRulesEmpty: No custom global rules configured. The selected permission mode remains active.
permissionPolicy.modeDescription: Used for new sessions and can be changed temporarily from the chat input.

toolPresentation.sectionDescription: Choose how the model accesses tools.
toolPresentation.description: Choose how tools are exposed to the model. This setting applies only to sessions created after it changes.

agentDelegation.sectionDescription: Open an assistant to your other devices or to connected accounts. Each outside task is its own session of that assistant, listed under it with its source, for you to review and approve. No assistant is open by default.
agentDelegation.noAssistants: This device has no assistants yet.
agentDelegation.closeFailed: Could not stop opening the assistant
agentDelegation.unsupportedEntry: No longer supported: only assistants can be opened now. This entry takes no tasks and can be deleted.
agentDelegation.unsupported: Assistants can be opened only from this device's desktop app.
agentDelegation.peerUnsupported: Manage the assistants of a connected device on that device.
agentDelegation.usageNotice: On outside tasks the assistant has its full abilities and can call external agents such as Claude Code. They run with this device's own login or credentials and use your quota with their provider.
agentDelegation.devicesDescription: Optional. You can also grant it to other accounts only.
agentDelegation.noDevices: No other devices of this account were found. Allow all devices, or grant the assistant to other accounts after opening it.
agentDelegation.grantDescription: They can give this assistant tasks. What it may do for them follows the trust level you choose for the connection under Connections with other accounts.
agentDelegation.noConnections: No usable connection with another account. Pair a device under Connections with other accounts first.
agentDelegation.connectionMissing: Connection {{id}}, no longer on this device

limits.title: Limits for this account
limits.description: Optional. Leave empty for no limit. A turn that runs past the time limit is stopped.
limits.invalid: Tasks at once must be 1-100 and minutes per turn 1-1440.

delegationAudit.sectionDescription: Tasks that devices of other accounts delegated to this device, newest first. The record stays on this device.
delegationAudit.empty: No tasks were delegated to this device by other accounts.
delegationAudit.loadFailed: Failed to load the record of delegated tasks
delegationAudit.unsupported: The record of delegated tasks is kept on the device that ran them; open it there.

connections.sectionDescription: Pair this device with a device of another account. Before accepting, both people compare the device fingerprints. Nothing is shared over a connection until you grant it, and either side can revoke it at any time.
connections.unsupported: Connections with other accounts are available only in the desktop app on this device.
connections.peerUnsupported: Manage the connections of a connected device on that device.
connections.signedOut: Sign in to an account to connect with devices of other accounts.
connections.relayUnsupported: The relay does not support connections between accounts
connections.relayUnsupportedDescription: Existing connections are shown, but new invites, accepts and revocations need a relay with cross-account routing.
connections.relayUnavailable: The relay could not be reached; showing the connections stored on this device
connections.localFingerprintDescription: Read it to the other person so they can check it on their screen.
connections.unreadable: Disabled, the record could not be read: {{problem}}

status.pending: Waiting for the inviter to confirm
status.keyChanged: Disabled: the other device's key changed; pair again
status.notVerified: Not verified on this device; revoke it and pair again

invite.createdDescription: Send it to the other person over a channel you trust. It expires at {{time}}.
invite.copyFailed: Could not copy the invite link

accept.linkDescription: Paste the link the other person sent you.
accept.previewDescription: Device {{device}} · the fingerprint matches the invite link · expires at {{time}}
accept.doneDescription: Read this device's fingerprint to the inviter. The connection becomes active once they confirm.

confirm.title: Confirm the connection with {{name}}
confirm.description: Ask {{name}} to read the fingerprint shown on their device. Confirm only if it matches this one exactly.

errors.relay_unsupported: The relay does not support connections between accounts.
errors.fingerprint_mismatch: The device key does not match the fingerprint. Do not accept; ask for a new invite.
errors.different_relay: The invite was created on another relay than the one this device uses.
errors.invalid_invite_link: This is not a valid invite link.
errors.invite_expired: The invite has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.invite_used: The invite has already been used.
errors.same_account: The invite comes from your own account. Devices of one account are connected already.
errors.connection_exists: These two devices are already connected.
errors.inviter_device_required: Only the device that created the invite can confirm.
errors.store_unreadable: The connections file on this device cannot be read. It is kept unchanged; repair or move it to pair again.

trust.confirmDescription: With full trust their tasks run like your own: the assistant can read your profile (USER.md) and memories and use every tool, including controlling the desktop, reading your other sessions and publishing. Memories are shared by all assistants. Under normal trust none of this is available, and reading your profile asks you first.
trust.fullSaved: This connection is trusted fully from its next task turn.
trust.normalSaved: Trusted normally. When the assistant runs commands or external agents, only your approval protects you.

projectPermissions.description: Always allow decisions are saved as remembered grants for the current project; static project rules apply before a tool runs.
projectPermissions.grantsEmpty: No remembered grants for the current project.
projectPermissions.removeGrantMessage: Remove the remembered {{action}} grant for {{resource}}? The next matching request will ask again.
projectPermissions.clearGrantsMessage: Remove every remembered permission grant for the current project? The next matching requests will ask again.
projectPermissions.rulesLoadFailed: Failed to load static project rules
projectPermissions.rulesSaveFailed: Failed to save static project rules
projectPermissions.rulesConflict: The rules file changed outside OpenBitFun. Reopen project permissions before saving.

deferredToolLoading.sectionDescription: Provide tool details to the model on demand to reduce context usage
deferredToolLoading.warning: Turning this off loads every tool definition and may increase model usage.

computerUse.sectionDescription: Allow OpenBitFun to view the screen and use the mouse and keyboard.
computerUse.enableDesc: When off, OpenBitFun cannot control desktop apps. Browser access is managed separately.
computerUse.accessibilityDesc: Allows OpenBitFun to identify and interact with controls in other apps.
computerUse.screenCaptureDesc: Allows OpenBitFun to see the contents of your screen.
computerUse.statusLoadFailed: Desktop control status could not be read. Related settings are locked until you refresh.
computerUse.desktopOnly: Desktop control is only available in the OpenBitFun desktop app.
computerUse.peerUnsupported: Desktop control runs on the connected peer host. This peer host (CLI) does not support it, so it cannot be configured here.

platformNotes.macos: This build still needs Accessibility permission in System Settings.
platformNotes.windows: Some protected windows or remote desktop environments may not be controllable.
platformNotes.linux: This desktop environment may not support full mouse, keyboard, or screen control.
platformNotes.generic: Full desktop control is not available on this system.

browserControl.sectionDescription: Allow agents to inspect and interact with browser pages after connecting
browserControl.desktopOnly: Browser control is only available in the OpenBitFun desktop app.
browserControl.peerUnsupported: Browser control runs on the connected peer host. This peer host (CLI) does not support it, so it cannot be configured here.
browserControl.preferredBrowserDesc: The default option follows your system browser.
browserControl.statusLoadFailed: Browser control status could not be read. Related settings are locked until you refresh.
browserControl.defaultCdpDesc: Use an open Chrome or Edge window and keep its tabs and signed-in accounts. The browser still confirms each connection.
browserControl.autoConnectOnStartupDesc: Connect to an open browser when OpenBitFun starts. The browser may ask again after it restarts.
browserControl.defaultCdpEnablePrompt: Trying to open {{browser}}'s Remote debugging page. Tick “Allow remote debugging for this browser instance”. If the page does not open, enter {{url}} in the browser address bar. OpenBitFun will detect the setting and continue automatically; then choose “Allow” in the browser prompt.
browserControl.defaultCdpConnectPrompt: Connecting to your current {{browser}}. Choose “Allow” in the browser prompt. If no request appears, enter {{url}} in the browser address bar and check the Remote debugging setting.
browserControl.disconnectSuccess: Disconnected from {{browser}}. Browser tabs remain open and the Remote debugging setting is unchanged.
browserControl.disconnectFailed: Could not disconnect from the browser
browserControl.userProfileSetupRequired: {{browser}}'s Remote debugging setting was not detected before the wait ended. Enter {{url}} in the browser address bar, tick “Allow remote debugging for this browser instance”, then click Enable and connect again; your current tabs and login state are preserved.
browserControl.userProfileSetupManual: Open {{url}} in {{browser}} and tick “Allow remote debugging for this browser instance”, then click Enable and connect again; your current tabs and login state are preserved.
browserControl.userProfileConnectionFailed: {{browser}} did not approve the connection, or the request timed out. Make sure the browser is running and Remote debugging is enabled, then connect again and choose Allow in the browser.
browserControl.restartFailed: Could not restart and connect to {{browser}}

restartModal.warning: This will close the current browser windows.
